title: ID0378743-DC/Si-D/UK[170000136] - Router 2 Signal Strength
description:
Technical Query:
What is the value in the logs regarding Signal Strength?
Root cause:
N/A
Solution:
Code below for the AWS, only for Router 1. Raise a request to the RM for a feature request to PLM.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
fields
@timestamp
,
@logStream
| filter
@message
like /signal strength/
| filter
@logStream
like /acno33/
| parse
@message
'"stdout":*'
as Signal
| parse Signal
'"LTE\",'
as RSSI
| parse RSSI
'*,'
as temp
| parse RSSI
',*'
as RSRP
| parse RSRP
',*'
as SINR
| parse RSRP
'*,'
as temp2
| parse SINR
'*,'
as temp3
| stats min(temp) as minRSSI, max(temp) as maxRSSI,min(temp2) as minRSRP, max(temp2) as maxRSRP,min(temp3) as minSINR, max(temp3) as maxSINR by
@logStream
| sort by
@timestamp
desc
| limit
10000
